title: Lost Mary Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava by Lost Mary is the iconic tropical blend. This e-liquid perfectly layers the sharp tang of Kiwi, the sweet, exotic notes of Passionfruit, and the smooth, juicy, and mellow flavour of Guava. It's a vibrant, balanced, and sun-soaked all-day vape. Lost Mary Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same intense and popular flavours the brand is famous for. This 10ml e-liquid collection is perfect for vapers seeking a reliable, flavour-packed experience in a refillable format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour and carries flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher strengths, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Lost Mary Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. They are ideal for use in low-wattage pod vape kits and starter vape kits. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
